# Three.js 0.186.1

Local browser modules copied without edits from the npm package `three@0.186.1`:

- `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`
- `examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `examples/jsm/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`, `SkeletonUtils.js`

The import map in index.html resolves the package name to this local copy. No CDN or npm installation is needed to play. The MIT license is preserved in LICENSE.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.186.1
